A single pin still supplies only 2; the detached mass/loop route also supplies only 2. Neither insufficiency may be repaired by inventing capacity, combining incompatible retainers, or restoring intact-H tapping within the substitute.
attack.invariant: The same two aligned panels must retain at least 4 units at ticks 3,4,5,6, then separate with every installed retainer removed by boundary 10. Preserve resources, one operator/action per tick, exclusive occupancy, and the prohibitions on damage, discard, substitution and outside resources.
attack.permitted_variable: Remove intact-H tapping as the preferred operating dependency. Explore the stipulated detached component routes while leaving hard requirements and the impact preference unchanged; no ladder cell is invoked.

Three candidates; no fresh builder.

candidates.burden: Two operator actions and one impact; H must be intact for tapping and P1 is occupied during the hold. Low action count cannot supply the missing capacity.
candidates.defeat: 2<4 at every hold tick; it additionally retains the operating dependency removed by CORE:S01. This is a forced negative exercise, not an organic failure.

handoff.residue: Both detached routes leave H disassembled; reassembly is not required by J01 and is not silently added. Sleeve capacity equals demand exactly and preparation has no slack. The mass/loop route exposes a real hard-capacity boundary; the single pin is the forced negative. Actual feedback is finite-model replay, not world execution.
handoff.summary: Replay all three candidates independently from intact H and all other available parts free. Require 4 units at ticks 3–6 and complete retainer removal by boundary 10. Exact sequences are supplied above; each action completes next boundary and only one action occurs per tick. The admissible substitutes remove intact-H tapping and never restore it. Use only J capacities and listed resources; Q is absent from J12, so no Q construction, measurement or assumed theta is admitted. No incompatible capacity combination, invented operation or manual support. Root owns final replay judgments.
